summary: This bill, titled the "James T. Woods Act," aims to combat online child exploitation by directing the U.S. Sentencing Commission to revise sentencing guidelines for child sexual abuse material offenses, creating a new federal crime for coercing minors to commit self-harm or harm to others, and criminalizing threats to distribute child sexual abuse material with intent to intimidate or extort.

scores.thoughts: This bill primarily focuses on increasing penalties and expanding the scope of offenses related to child sexual abuse material and online coercion of minors. It directs the U.S. Sentencing Commission to review and amend sentencing guidelines to ensure harsher penalties and better account for the complexity and dangerousness of these crimes. This clearly aligns with a stricter approach to justice and stronger policing in this specific area.
